scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun run --cwd packages/shm-native typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/retina-local-fs typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/shm-native test && bun run --cwd packages/retina-local-fs test
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/shm-native build:js && bun run --cwd packages/retina-local-fs build
scripts.check:repo: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build
